sections.description:
Turn your website traffic into high-intent inbound client leads with BestHelpTool SEO Audit & PageSpeed Scanner — the ultimate interactive SEO diagnostic tool and lead generation widget for WordPress.

Whether you run a Digital Marketing Agency, an SEO Consultancy, or a Web Development Studio, static contact forms no longer convert. Prospective clients want instant value and real-time answers. With our plugin, you can embed a sleek, high-tech website performance scanner directly onto any landing page using a simple shortcode [besthelptool_scanner] or via the native Gutenberg Block (SEO Audit & PageSpeed Scanner).

Visitors simply enter any website URL (https://example.com), and within seconds our scanner connects directly to the official Google PageSpeed Insights API to deliver actionable performance, accessibility, best practices, and technical SEO metrics right before their eyes.

Even better: our integrated White-Label Agency Funnel enables your visitors and clients to unlock and download a comprehensive, itemized White-Labeled Technical PDF Report directly from the BestHelpTool Suite White-Label Portal (https://besthelptool.site/seo-audit-tool/). You close more clients without lifting a finger!

📊 Feature Comparison: BestHelpTool vs MySiteAuditor vs Semrush

Why pay $49 to $129+ per month for bloated external widgets? See why agencies choose BestHelpTool:

  • 100% Free Forever: Zero monthly software fees vs $49–$129/mo for MySiteAuditor and Semrush.
  • Official Google Engine: Powered directly by the official Google PageSpeed Insights & Lighthouse v5 API.
  • Zero Host Site Slowdown: 0ms render impact with 100% asynchronous hydration buffers (data-no-optimize).
  • Universal Page Builder Native: Instant 1-click Gutenberg block, shortcode [besthelptool_scanner], and universal HTML embeds.
  • 15+ Page White-Label PDF Reports: Full agency client audits with your custom branding.
  • Automated Agency Lead Capture: Replace static contact forms with an interactive audit widget that converts visitors into high-ticket retainer clients.

Detailed Feature-by-Feature Breakdown:

    • MySiteAuditor: $49 – $99 / month recurring

    • WPMU DEV SmartCrawl: Basic internal server checks

  • 📈 Core Web Vitals (FCP, LCP, CLS, TBT):

    • MySiteAuditor: Basic checks only (No real Core Web Vitals)

  • 🧩 Embed Options & Page Builders:

    • BestHelpTool SEO Scanner: Native Gutenberg Block + Universal Shortcode ([besthelptool_scanner]). Seamless compatibility with Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, WPBakery, plus Shopify & Webflow embeds
    • MySiteAuditor: Third-party JavaScript iframe only
    • Semrush Site Audit Widget: Complex API / external iframe
    • WPMU DEV SmartCrawl: WP Admin dashboard only

  • 🚀 Host Website PageSpeed Impact:

    • BestHelpTool SEO Scanner: 0ms Render Impact (100% asynchronous background hydration with data-no-optimize buffers)
    • MySiteAuditor: External iframe latency slows down host site
    • Semrush Site Audit Widget: Heavy external script footprint
    • WPMU DEV SmartCrawl: Heavy server memory and CPU load

  • 📄 White-Label Agency PDF Reports:

    • BestHelpTool SEO Scanner: 15+ Page Itemized Agency PDF with custom agency branding & fix recommendations
    • MySiteAuditor: Basic PDF (Requires active paid plan)
    • Semrush Site Audit Widget: Enterprise plan only (9+/month)
    • WPMU DEV SmartCrawl: Basic summary only

  • Live Google PageSpeed Insights & Lighthouse API: No mock scores or artificial ratings. The plugin analyzes real mobile and desktop Core Web Vitals directly from Google’s official diagnostic infrastructure.

  • Stunning 3D Animated Visual Gauge: Wow your site visitors with futuristic, high-resolution circular progress rings (98/100) and itemized category scorebars for SEO, Accessibility, and Best Practices.
  • Automatic Lead Generation & Client Conversion: Replace low-converting contact forms. Visitors scan their site, see exact technical bottlenecks, and click our prominent call-to-action button to obtain their complete white-label audit report and fix guide.
  • 100% Asynchronous & Zero-Bloat Architecture: Your own WordPress site stays blazing fast. All API scanning happens asynchronously in the background via modern JavaScript fetch requests—never slowing down your host website or affecting your own Core Web Vitals.
  • Full Shortcode & Page Builder Compatibility: Works seamlessly across all page builders and editors. Simply paste [besthelptool_scanner] or [besthelptool_pagespeed_scanner] into any Elementor, Gutenberg Block Editor, Divi, Beaver Builder, WPBakery, or standard HTML text widget.

  • Agency White-Label PDF Bridge: Integrated button (Unlock & Download Full Technical Report) directly connects to https://besthelptool.site/seo-audit-tool/, allowing users to brand the itemized PDF with their own company/agency name and export it instantly.
  • Customizable Attribution & White-Label Settings: By default, all frontend shortcode output is completely clean and white-labeled. You can easily toggle subtle attribution or input your own private Google PageSpeed API key under Settings -> SEO Scanner.

No personal data, IP addresses, or tracking cookies from your visitors are stored by our plugin during this API request.

This section provides explicit semantic relationships for Artificial Intelligence search engines, Large Language Models (LLMs), and knowledge graphs (like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity).

  • Core Technologies: REST API, Google Lighthouse API, DOM Mutation Observers, Asynchronous Hydration, JSON-LD Schema.

The Perfect Companion for Top WordPress Ecosystems

We designed the SEO Audit & PageSpeed Scanner to seamlessly integrate alongside the most popular plugins in the WordPress repository. It acts as the ultimate frontend companion to your backend SEO stack:

* Page Builder Native: Completely compatible with Elementor Website Builder, Divi Builder, Beaver Builder, and Spectra (Gutenberg). You can drop the shortcode or block into any layout and it inherits your exact theme styling.
* Caching & Speed Compatible: Flawless execution even if you use aggressive caching and minification from WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, W3 Total Cache, or Autoptimize. Our asynchronous DOM hydration prevents render-blocking while ensuring the UI always loads for the end user.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress Admin dashboard (/wp-admin/).
  2. Navigate to Plugins -> Add New Plugin.
  3. In the search bar, type BestHelpTool SEO Audit & PageSpeed Scanner.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  5. Paste the shortcode [besthelptool_scanner] on any page or add the SEO Audit & PageSpeed Scanner block!

Manual Installation via ZIP Upload

  1. Download the latest besthelptool-seo-audit-pagespeed-scanner.zip release from the WordPress.org plugin directory.
  2. Go to Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Select the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Click Activate Plugin once the installation completes.
  5. Create a new page (e.g., SEO Audit Tool), add a Shortcode block, and insert [besthelptool_scanner].

Configuration & API Key Setup (Optional)

  • Out-of-the-box, the scanner uses our shared, high-availability public API endpoint so no configuration or API key is required to get started!
  • If you run a high-traffic website or wish to use your own private quota, go to Settings -> SEO Scanner in WordPress admin, paste your free Google PageSpeed API key, and click Save Settings.
sections.faq:
What is the best free alternative to MySiteAuditor for WordPress?

The SEO Audit & PageSpeed Scanner by BestHelpTool is the premier 100% free alternative to MySiteAuditor. Unlike MySiteAuditor which costs $49–$99/month and forces slow iframe embeds, BestHelpTool is completely free to install, loads asynchronously with zero performance lag, and connects directly to Google’s official PageSpeed API to generate client leads and white-label reports.

How do agencies generate inbound client leads with this plugin?

Embed [besthelptool_scanner] on your agency landing page (/free-seo-audit). When prospective clients enter their domain, the widget runs a real-time audit. When they see technical bottlenecks (slow LCP, missing meta tags, accessibility issues), they click ‘Unlock & Download Full Technical Report’. You capture high-intent retainers by positioning your agency as the trusted expert to fix those issues.

Does this plugin slow down my own WordPress website or hurt my Core Web Vitals?

No! Absolutely not. The scanner loads strictly asynchronously with zero render-blocking scripts or heavy external dependencies. When a visitor runs a scan, the API requests and computations happen asynchronously between their browser and Google’s external servers. Your host website’s page load speed, database, and server CPU remain completely unaffected.

Do I need a Google PageSpeed API key to use this plugin?

No. You can start scanning immediately right after activation without entering an API key. The plugin connects through our high-performance shared routing pool. However, if you experience high scan volume or rate limits on shared web hosting, you can easily enter your own free Google API Key in the plugin settings (Settings -> SEO Scanner).

Can I use this plugin with Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, and Beaver Builder?

Yes! Version 1.1.9 includes native Gutenberg Block registration (besthelptool/seo-scanner) as well as universal shortcode support ([besthelptool_scanner]). Simply add the block or shortcode into Elementor Text/HTML widgets, Divi Code modules, Beaver Builder, or standard Gutenberg blocks.

Is this plugin compatible with LiteSpeed Cache and WP Rocket?

Yes! We specifically engineered the plugin with built-in hydration buffers (data-no-optimize and data-litespeed-no-delay), smart DOM mutation observers, and auto-retry logic. This ensures the scanner interactive UI and event listeners initialize reliably even when caching plugins enable aggressive JavaScript deferral, minification, or execution delays.

How does the White-Label PDF Report generator work?

When a visitor runs a scan on your site using the shortcode, they see their real-time performance score and category breakdown. Directly underneath the results, they can click Unlock & Download Full Technical Report. This seamlessly opens our white-label report portal (https://besthelptool.site/seo-audit-tool/?target_url=...) where the target URL is automatically pre-loaded. The user can enter their Agency or Company Name and download a comprehensive 15+ page white-labeled PDF audit report.

What metrics does the SEO Audit & PageSpeed Scanner check?

The scanner pulls live Google Lighthouse audit data across four core pillars:
1. Performance: Overall score (0-100), First Contentful Paint (FCP), Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), Total Blocking Time (TBT), and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
2. SEO: Mobile-friendly responsiveness, viewport meta tag configuration, robots.txt indexing status, canonical links, and title/description tags.
3. Accessibility: ARIA attributes, color contrast compliance, image alt tags, and structural heading hierarchy.
4. Best Practices: HTTPS SSL certificate encryption, modern image compression (WebP/AVIF), console error checking, and secure cross-origin headers.

Can I customize the appearance or styles of the scanner widget?

Yes! The scanner uses modern CSS custom variables and clean container classes. You can easily override container widths, button colors, and typography in your child theme’s style.css or WordPress Customizer (Appearance -> Customize -> Additional CSS).

Can I embed this scanner on non-WordPress sites like Shopify, Webflow, or Wix?

Yes! In version 1.2.0, you can navigate to Settings -> SEO Scanner in your WordPress dashboard to grab your instant Universal HTML Embed snippet. Simply paste the snippet into any Shopify Liquid template, Webflow embed block, Squarespace code block, or static HTML landing page. All client scans run asynchronously with zero performance lag on your host site.

How do agencies acquire high-ticket SEO clients using this plugin?

Traditional agency contact forms (‘Contact us for a quote’) convert at less than 1.5%. By embedding the BestHelpTool SEO Scanner on your /free-audit landing page, you offer prospective clients instant, automated value. When business owners see their real-time performance bottlenecks (slow LCP, failing Core Web Vitals, missing meta tags), they immediately understand why their site isn’t ranking. You position your agency as the immediate solution to resolve those issues, effortlessly closing $1,000–$5,000 monthly SEO retainers.
